title: benchmarkWorkspace
responsibility: Creates pinned regular-file workspaces and overlays only allowed implementation changes.

inputs.name: benchmarkGit.cwd
inputs.description: Directory passed as the subprocess working directory for the Git command. It determines which repository Git uses; an unavailable directory can make the command fail.

inputs.name: benchmarkGit.args
inputs.description: Git arguments appended after the command disables repository hooks. They select the Git action and options; a nonzero Git exit code causes an Error.

inputs.name: benchmarkFiles.project
inputs.description: Repository directory used as the Git working directory while listing the selected tree. It must contain the repository and revision being read.

inputs.name: benchmarkFiles.revision
inputs.description: Git revision expression passed to `git ls-tree` to select the tree. It must resolve in the specified repository; entries other than regular-file blobs are rejected.

inputs.name: snapshotBenchmark.project
inputs.description: Repository directory used for listing and archiving the selected tree. It must contain the repository and revision being read.

inputs.name: snapshotBenchmark.revision
inputs.description: Git revision expression passed to tree listing and archive creation. It selects the snapshot; unsupported tree entries cause an Error.

inputs.name: snapshotBenchmark.destination
inputs.description: Directory created for extracted snapshot files. The function extracts the archive there and creates a temporary `snapshot.tar` beside it.

inputs.name: createBenchmarkWorkspace.baseline
inputs.description: Directory recursively copied into the new workspace before Git is initialized. Its contents become the forced-added baseline commit.

inputs.name: createBenchmarkWorkspace.destination
inputs.description: Workspace destination that is recursively removed before the baseline is copied. Git is initialized there and the copied files are committed.

inputs.name: regularBenchmarkFile.root
inputs.description: Directory prefix used to resolve the file path one slash-separated segment at a time. The joined segments are checked for missing entries and symlinks.

inputs.name: regularBenchmarkFile.file
inputs.description: Slash-separated path joined to the root for the regular-file check. Every joined segment must exist without being a symlink, and the final entry must be a file.

inputs.name: benchmarkFileValue.root
inputs.description: Directory prefix used to resolve the file before its mode and contents are read. The value is returned only when the path passes the regular nonsymlink-file check.

inputs.name: benchmarkFileValue.file
inputs.description: Slash-separated path joined to the root for the file check and fingerprint. Missing or symlinked segments produce `undefined` rather than a fingerprint.

inputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles.source
inputs.description: Root from which each listed path is checked and, when it is a regular file, read. Missing or nonregular source paths cause the matching target path to be removed.

inputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles.target
inputs.description: Root whose listed destinations are updated. Listed files are copied with their source mode or removed, and parent directories are created when needed.

inputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles.files
inputs.description: Paths processed in order against the source and target roots. Each regular source file is copied; a missing, symlinked, or otherwise nonregular source path triggers removal of the matching target entry.

outputs.name: benchmarkGit
outputs.description: Standard output captured from a successful Git subprocess. A nonzero exit code throws before any string is returned.

outputs.name: benchmarkFiles
outputs.description: Relative paths parsed from the selected tree after all entries pass the regular-blob mode check. Symlinks and submodules are rejected.

outputs.name: snapshotBenchmark
outputs.description: Relative paths retained from the selected tree after extraction and regular-file checks. Export-ignore archives that omit a listed path are rejected.

outputs.name: createBenchmarkWorkspace
outputs.description: No value; on success the destination contains a Git repository with the copied baseline committed. The destination is cleared before copying.

outputs.name: regularBenchmarkFile
outputs.description: Whether every joined path segment exists without being a symlink and the final entry is a regular file. Missing or symlinked segments return false.

outputs.name: benchmarkFileValue
outputs.description: The final file’s executable permission bits followed by its SHA-256 digest, or `undefined` when the regular-file check fails. The permission portion is the decimal rendering of `mode & 0o111`.

outputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles
outputs.description: No value; listed regular files are copied with their source mode, while other listed source paths cause target removal. Paths not listed are not directly overlaid.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Benchmark operations reject with Error for Git failures, unsupported tree entries, archive extraction or completeness failures, and filesystem failures. Explicit validation failures use the messages in the implementation; underlying filesystem and subprocess errors propagate.

inputs.name: benchmarkGit.cwd
inputs.description: Directory passed as the subprocess working directory for the Git command. It determines which repository Git uses; an unavailable directory can make the command fail.

inputs.name: benchmarkGit.args
inputs.description: Git arguments appended after the command disables repository hooks. They select the Git action and options; a nonzero Git exit code causes an Error.

outputs.name: benchmarkGit
outputs.description: Standard output captured from a successful Git subprocess. A nonzero exit code throws before any string is returned.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects if the Git subprocess fails or exits with a nonzero status. A nonzero exit status is raised as Error with the benchmark Git failure message.

inputs.name: benchmarkFiles.project
inputs.description: Repository directory used as the Git working directory while listing the selected tree. It must contain the repository and revision being read.

inputs.name: benchmarkFiles.revision
inputs.description: Git revision expression passed to `git ls-tree` to select the tree. It must resolve in the specified repository; entries other than regular-file blobs are rejected.

outputs.name: benchmarkFiles
outputs.description: Relative paths parsed from the selected tree after all entries pass the regular-blob mode check. Symlinks and submodules are rejected.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with Error when Git fails or a tree entry is not a `100644 blob` or `100755 blob` regular-file entry.

inputs.name: snapshotBenchmark.project
inputs.description: Repository directory used for listing and archiving the selected tree. It must contain the repository and revision being read.

inputs.name: snapshotBenchmark.revision
inputs.description: Git revision expression passed to tree listing and archive creation. It selects the snapshot; unsupported tree entries cause an Error.

inputs.name: snapshotBenchmark.destination
inputs.description: Directory created for extracted snapshot files. The function extracts the archive there and creates a temporary `snapshot.tar` beside it.

outputs.name: snapshotBenchmark
outputs.description: Relative paths retained from the selected tree after extraction and regular-file checks. Export-ignore archives that omit a listed path are rejected.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with Error on Git failure, an unsupported tree entry, tar extraction failure, or a listed snapshot file missing after extraction.

inputs.name: createBenchmarkWorkspace.baseline
inputs.description: Directory recursively copied into the new workspace before Git is initialized. Its contents become the forced-added baseline commit.

inputs.name: createBenchmarkWorkspace.destination
inputs.description: Workspace destination that is recursively removed before the baseline is copied. Git is initialized there and the copied files are committed.

outputs.name: createBenchmarkWorkspace
outputs.description: No value; on success the destination contains a Git repository with the copied baseline committed. The destination is cleared before copying.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects if destination removal or baseline copying fails, or if any Git initialization, add, or commit command fails.

inputs.name: regularBenchmarkFile.root
inputs.description: Directory prefix used to resolve the file path one slash-separated segment at a time. The joined segments are checked for missing entries and symlinks.

inputs.name: regularBenchmarkFile.file
inputs.description: Slash-separated path joined to the root for the regular-file check. Every joined segment must exist without being a symlink, and the final entry must be a file.

outputs.name: regularBenchmarkFile
outputs.description: Whether every joined path segment exists without being a symlink and the final entry is a regular file. Missing or symlinked segments return false.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Can reject if the final filesystem lookup fails after the segment checks, such as when the path changes during traversal. Missing or symlinked segments encountered by the loop return false.

inputs.name: benchmarkFileValue.root
inputs.description: Directory prefix used to resolve the file before its mode and contents are read. The value is returned only when the path passes the regular nonsymlink-file check.

inputs.name: benchmarkFileValue.file
inputs.description: Slash-separated path joined to the root for the file check and fingerprint. Missing or symlinked segments produce `undefined` rather than a fingerprint.

outputs.name: benchmarkFileValue
outputs.description: The final file’s executable permission bits followed by its SHA-256 digest, or `undefined` when the regular-file check fails. The permission portion is the decimal rendering of `mode & 0o111`.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Can reject if filesystem metadata or file reading fails after the regular-file check. A path that fails the check returns undefined instead.

inputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles.source
inputs.description: Root from which each listed path is checked and, when it is a regular file, read. Missing or nonregular source paths cause the matching target path to be removed.

inputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles.target
inputs.description: Root whose listed destinations are updated. Listed files are copied with their source mode or removed, and parent directories are created when needed.

inputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles.files
inputs.description: Paths processed in order against the source and target roots. Each regular source file is copied; a missing, symlinked, or otherwise nonregular source path triggers removal of the matching target entry.

outputs.name: overlayBenchmarkFiles
outputs.description: No value; listed regular files are copied with their source mode, while other listed source paths cause target removal. Paths not listed are not directly overlaid.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Can reject if target removal, directory creation, source reading, target writing, or permission updating fails.
